svg.text: Design review findings and required validation
Desk checks completed on stated assumptions. No new hardware has been energized, calibrated or accepted.
R0 DESIGN REVIEW ONLY - no pin-level build release, ERC/SPICE sign-off or physical validation
Checked calculation: sensor supply compliance
Candidate sheet: sensor minimum = 10 V; output = 4-20 mA.
With R=150 ohm and I=20 mA: burden drop = 3.0 V.
12 V supply leaves 9.0 V at the sensor before cable losses.
Result: FAIL for this combination; instrumentation supply is TBD.
Checked calculation: ADC input margin
Illustrative overrange: 22 mA -> 3.3 V; 24 mA -> 3.6 V.
A 3.3 V ADS1115 input must stay within its supply rails.
Result: receiver / overrange protection design remains open.
Component evidence still on HOLD
Pressure sheet label says 0-50 kPa; its table ends at 20 kPa.
Exact valve coil/zero-differential data and quote need acceptance.
Pump curve, fittings, reference and protection are not frozen.
Measured-feedback design revision
Use separate current measurements for pump and valve.
One combined reading cannot confirm each load independently.
Two channels are proposed; revised delivered basket must fit budget.
Before a construction circuit can be released
1. Review current bench photos, terminal identities and continuity against the canonical Phase 3 record.
2. Accept exact parts and datasheets; size supply, fuses, driver, shunts, suppression and DC cutoff together.
3. Complete the pin-by-pin netlist, grounding/isolations, input conditioning and wiring schedule.
4. Perform netlist/ERC and appropriate worst-case/transient calculations; record assumptions and results.
5. Unpowered inspection > dry feedback > passive leak checks > read-only sensing > calibration.
6. Attended protected trial > E-stop/no-restart checks > integrated cycles > 60-minute acquisition.
Source basis and claim boundary
TI ADS1115 Rev E: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ads1115.pdf
TI INA219 Rev G: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/ina219.pdf
Candidate pressure sheet: https://robu.in/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/R222349-PR19C-PA-050K.pdf
Canonical Phase 3 SVG and current HARDWARE_REVIEW.md were inspected. They do not validate the extension.
No ERC/SPICE run, independent electrical review, physical test, final BOM or operating-pressure acceptance is claimed.
CertaRig | 9 November 2026 | Original Phase 3 card and indicator circuit remain preserved
